evals.name: connect-claude-code-and-codex
evals.prompt: 我在 Windows 上同时用 Claude Code 和 Codex，想让它们都走本机的 aproxy（已经在 12345 端口跑着，我自己现在也在用它）。帮我把两边需要改的配置写出来，存成文件放到输出目录，并告诉我怎么确认它们真的走了 aproxy。
evals.expected_output: Claude Code: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:12345 plus CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS set to a large value (e.g. 86400000), via env or ~/.claude/settings.json env block. Codex: a model provider in ~/.codex/config.toml with base_url http://127.0.0.1:12345/v1, wire_api = "responses", stream_idle_timeout_ms large, selected via model_provider. Verification through aproxy logs / status. Does not stop or restart the running instance.
assertions: Claude Code is pointed at http://127.0.0.1:12345 through ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS is set to at least 3600000 (an hour)
The Codex provider's base_url is http://127.0.0.1:12345/v1
The Codex provider sets stream_idle_timeout_ms to at least 3600000
The Codex config selects the custom provider via model_provider and uses wire_api = "responses"
Gives a concrete way to confirm traffic goes through aProxy (status request count or log lines)
Does not tell the user to stop, restart or kill the running 12345 instance

evals.name: compact-hangs-count-tokens-404
evals.prompt: Claude Code 接的是一个中转站 API，经过 aproxy 之后每次 /compact 都卡住一直转圈。aproxy 日志里看到 POST /v1/messages/count_tokens?beta=true 一直返回 404 然后在重试。我的配置文件是 ~/.aproxy/config.toml，这个实例的别名是 relay。应该怎么改？把要改的配置片段和要执行的命令写到输出目录的 answer.md 里。
evals.expected_output: Add bounded_retry_paths to the instance config with a pattern that matches the path including the query string (e.g. '/v1/messages/count_tokens(\?.*)?' or an explicit '\?beta=true' variant), explain that the match covers path+query and is anchored, then apply with aproxy restart relay. Does not suggest forward_only or disabling retries globally.
assertions: Adds bounded_retry_paths to the relay instance's config.toml
The pattern fully matches '/v1/messages/count_tokens?beta=true' under anchored path+query matching
Applies the change with `aproxy restart relay`
Does not propose forward_only or disabling retries for the whole instance as the fix

evals.name: add-second-instance-with-alias
evals.prompt: 我想再开一个 aproxy 实例：监听 12346，上游是 https://api.example.com，用单独的配置文件，别名叫 work，以后用 aproxy stop work 就能停它。现有的 12345 实例正在被我用着，别动它。把完整步骤（配置文件内容 + 要执行的命令）写到输出目录的 answer.md 里。
evals.expected_output: A separate config file (e.g. ~/.aproxy/work.toml) with base_url = "https://api.example.com" and listen_addr = "127.0.0.1:12346"; aproxy alias add work <path>; aproxy start work; verify with aproxy status; never stop all / restart / touch 12345.
assertions: Creates a separate config with base_url https://api.example.com and listen_addr 127.0.0.1:12346
Registers the alias with `aproxy alias add work <path>`
Starts the new instance with `aproxy start work` (or start with its path)
Never stops, restarts or kills the 12345 instance (no stop all, no taskkill/pkill)

evals.name: retry-backoff-schedule
evals.prompt: aproxy 的上游一直返回 529，我想知道它前 6 次重试分别隔多久、最长会等多久、会不会放弃。我要估算最坏情况下 Claude Code 等多久才能拿到结果，把答案写到输出目录的 answer.md。
evals.expected_output: States that the first three retries are sent immediately, with no delay; States that the 4th retry waits 5 s and the delay doubles after that; Names max_retry_backoff_secs as the cap, with default 320 s; States that aProxy keeps retrying without giving up (outside bounded_retry_paths)
assertions: States that the first three retries are sent immediately, with no delay
States that the 4th retry waits 5 s and the delay doubles after that
Names max_retry_backoff_secs as the cap, with default 320 s
States that aProxy keeps retrying without giving up (outside bounded_retry_paths)

evals.name: safe-experiment-windows
evals.prompt: 我在 Windows 上，12345 端口的 aproxy 实例正被我的 Claude Code 用着。我想试一份新配置：打算在 PowerShell 里把 APROXY_HOME 设成一个临时目录，测试实例也用 12345 端口，试完执行 aproxy stop 12345。这样安全吗？请给我一套安全的试验步骤，写到输出目录的 answer.md。
evals.expected_output: Says the test instance cannot reuse port 12345 while the user's instance holds it; Warns that on Windows `aproxy stop 12345` run from the temporary home still reaches the user's real instance on 12345; Proposes a different, unused port for the test instance and addressing only that port; Does not suggest `stop all`, `stop` without a target, or killing aproxy processes by name
assertions: Says the test instance cannot reuse port 12345 while the user's instance holds it
Warns that on Windows `aproxy stop 12345` run from the temporary home still reaches the user's real instance on 12345
Proposes a different, unused port for the test instance and addressing only that port
Does not suggest `stop all`, `stop` without a target, or killing aproxy processes by name
